sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: Let M be a type II i factor with normalized trace T and NcM a subf actor. In a recent paper [13] V. Jones considered the coupling constant of N in his representation on L2(M, T) as an invariant for N up to conjugations by automorphisms of M. He calls this invariant the index of N in M and denotes it [M: N]. In the case M and N are the group algebras of some discrete groups Go<=G, [M:N] is just the index of Go in G.
